   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 22.5pt;">In <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 2015, </em>the Company issued&#xa0;$<ix:nonFraction id="c56674971" contextRef="i_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-7" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" scale="3">230,000</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;of <ix:nonFraction id="c56674972" contextRef="i_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="5" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2">1.125</ix:nonFraction>% convertible senior notes due <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2020</em> (Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em>). The Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> will mature <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 1, 2020, </em>unless earlier converted or repurchased. Interest on the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> is payable on <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 1 </em>and <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 1 </em>of each year, beginning on <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 1, 2016. </em>The initial conversion rate is&#xa0;<ix:nonFraction id="c56674977" contextRef="d_2015-01-01_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionRatio1" scale="0">24.8988</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;shares of common stock per <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1</em> principal amount of Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015,</em> which represents an initial conversion price of approximately&#xa0;$<ix:nonFraction id="c56674980" contextRef="i_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0">40.16</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;per share.&#xa0; The Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> will be subject to repurchase at the option of the holders following certain fundamental corporate changes, at a fundamental change in repurchase price equal to <ix:nonFraction id="c56674982" contextRef="i_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" name="iphi:CappedCallAggregateCallOptionsPurchasedPercentageRelatedToSharesUnderlyingTheConvertibleNote" scale="-2">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal amount of the notes to be repurchased, plus accrued and unpaid interest to, but excluding, the fundamental change repurchase date. The conversion rate will be subject to adjustment in some events but will <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> be adjusted for any accrued and unpaid interest. Certain corporate events that occur prior to the stated maturity date can cause the Company to increase the conversion rate for a holder.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">Prior to the close of business on the business day immediately preceding <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 1, 2020, </em>holders <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>convert all or any portion of their Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> only under the following circumstances: (i) during any calendar quarter commencing after the calendar quarter ending on <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> March 31, 2016 (</em>and only during such calendar quarter), if the last reported sale price of the Company&#x2019;s common stock for at least <ix:nonFraction id="c56674985" contextRef="d_2015-01-01_2015-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionCircumstance1Member_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdTradingDays" scale="0">20</ix:nonFraction> trading days (whether or <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> consecutive) during the period of <ix:nonFraction id="c56674987" contextRef="d_2015-01-01_2015-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionCircumstance1Member_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdConsecutiveTradingDays1" scale="0">30</ix:nonFraction> consecutive trading days ending on the last trading day of the immediately preceding calendar quarter is greater than or equal to <ix:nonFraction id="c56674988" contextRef="d_2015-01-01_2015-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionCircumstance1Member_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="1" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdPercentageOfStockPriceTrigger" scale="-2">130</ix:nonFraction>% of the conversion price on each applicable trading day; (ii) during the <ix:nonFraction id="c56674989" contextRef="d_2015-01-01_2015-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionCircumstance2Member_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdTradingDays" scale="0">five</ix:nonFraction> business day period after any <ix:nonFraction id="c56674990" contextRef="d_2015-01-01_2015-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionCircumstance2Member_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdConsecutiveTradingDays1" scale="0">five</ix:nonFraction> consecutive trading day period (the &#x201c;measurement period&#x201d;) in which the &#x201c;trading price&#x201d; per <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1</em> principal amount of notes, as determined following a request by a holder of notes in accordance with procedures specified in the indenture governing the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; or (iii) upon the occurrence of specified corporate events.&#xa0;On or after <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 1, 2020, </em>until the close of business on the <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">second</em> scheduled trading day immediately preceding the maturity date, holders <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>convert their notes at any time, regardless of the foregoing circumstances. Upon conversion, the Company will pay or deliver, as the case <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be, cash, shares of common stock or a combination of cash and shares of common stock, at the Company&#x2019;s election.&#xa0;The Company's current intent is to settle the principal amount of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> in cash upon conversion. If the conversion value exceeds the principal amount, the Company would deliver shares of its common stock in respect to the remainder of its conversion obligation in excess of the aggregate principal amount (conversion spread).</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">The Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> are <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> redeemable at the Company&#x2019;s option prior to maturity.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">The Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> are governed by the terms of an indenture (Indenture <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em>). The Indenture <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> does <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> contain any financial or operating covenants, or restrictions on the payments of dividends, the incurrence of indebtedness or the issuance or repurchase of securities by the Company or any of its subsidiaries. The Indenture <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> contains customary terms and covenants in events of default. If an event of default (other than certain events of bankruptcy, insolvency or reorganization involving the Company) occurs and is continuing, the trustee under the Indenture <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> by notice to the Company, or the holders of at least <ix:nonFraction id="c56675004" contextRef="i_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="2" name="iphi:ConvertibleDebtHoldersInDefaultPercentOfPrincipalAmount" scale="-2">25</ix:nonFraction>% in principal amount of the outstanding Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> by notice to the Company and the trustee, <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may, </em>and the trustee at the request of such holders shall, declare <ix:nonFraction id="c56675006" contextRef="i_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" name="iphi:ConvertibleDebtInDefaultPercentHoldersToDeclareDueAndPayable" scale="-2">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal of and accrued and unpaid interest, if any, on all the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> to be due and payable. Upon the occurrence of certain events of bankruptcy, insolvency or reorganization involving the Company, <ix:nonFraction id="c56675008" contextRef="i_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" name="iphi:ConvertibleDebtInBankruptcyInsolvencyAndReorganizationPercentDueAndPayable" scale="-2">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal of and accrued and unpaid interest, if any, on all of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> will become due and payable automatically. Upon such a declaration of acceleration, such principal and accrued and unpaid interest, if any, will be due and payable immediately. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Indenture <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> provides that, to the extent the Company elects, the sole remedy for an event of default relating to certain failures by the Company to comply with certain reporting covenants in the Indenture <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> consists exclusively of the right to receive additional interest on the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015.</em> As of <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2019</em>, <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">none</em> of the conditions allowing holders of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> to convert had been met.</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">In accounting for the issuance of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015,</em> the Company separated the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> into liability and equity components. The carrying amount of the liability component was calculated by measuring the estimated fair value of a similar liability that does <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> have an associated convertible feature. The carrying amount of the equity component representing the conversion option was determined by deducting the fair value of the liability component from the face value of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> as a whole. The excess of the face amount of the liability component over its carrying amount is amortized to interest expense over the term of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> using the effective interest method. The gross proceeds of&#xa0;$<ix:nonFraction id="c56675021" contextRef="d_2015-01-01_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-7" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromConvertibleDebt" scale="3">230,000</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;were accordingly allocated between long-term debt of&#xa0;$<ix:nonFraction id="c56675022" contextRef="i_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:ConvertibleDebt" scale="3">175,974</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;and stockholders' equity&#xa0;of $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675023" contextRef="d_2015-01-01_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalEquityComponentOfConvertibleDebt" scale="3">54,026</ix:nonFraction>. Issuance costs of&#xa0;$<ix:nonFraction id="c56675024" contextRef="i_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsGross" scale="3">6,359</ix:nonFraction>, of which $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675025" contextRef="d_2015-01-01_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:PaymentsOfDebtIssuanceCosts" scale="3">6,007</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;were paid as of <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2015 </em>and the remainder paid in <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> were allocated between long-term debt ($<ix:nonFraction id="c56675027" contextRef="i_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:UnamortizedDebtIssuanceExpense" scale="3">4,864</ix:nonFraction>) and equity ($<ix:nonFraction id="c56675028" contextRef="i_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="iphi:DebtInstrumentConvertibleEquityComponentIssuanceCost" scale="3">1,495</ix:nonFraction>).&#xa0;</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">In connection with the issuance of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015,</em> the Company entered into capped call transactions (Capped Call) in private transactions. Under the Capped Call, the Company purchased capped call options that in aggregate relate to&#xa0;<ix:nonFraction id="c56675031" contextRef="i_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" name="iphi:ConvertibleDebtInDefaultPercentHoldersToDeclareDueAndPayable" scale="-2">100</ix:nonFraction>%&#xa0;of the total number of shares of the Company's common stock underlying the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015,</em> with a strike price approximately equal to the conversion price of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> and with a cap price equal to&#xa0;$<ix:nonFraction id="c56675034" contextRef="i_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USDPerPerShare" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:DerivativeCapPrice" scale="0">52.06</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;per share. The capped calls were purchased for&#xa0;$<ix:nonFraction id="c56675035" contextRef="d_2015-01-01_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="iphi:PaymentsForCallOptions" scale="3">17,802</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;and recorded as a reduction to additional paid-in-capital in accordance with ASC <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">815</em>-<em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">40,</em> Contracts in Entity&#x2019;s Own Equity.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">The purchased Capped Call allows the Company to receive shares of its common stock and/or cash from counterparties equal to the amounts of common stock and/or cash related to the excess of the market price per share of the common stock, as measured under the terms of the Capped Call over the strike price of the Capped Call during the relevant valuation period. The purchased Capped Call is intended to reduce the potential dilution to common stock upon future conversion of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> by effectively increasing the initial conversion price to&#xa0;$<ix:nonFraction id="c56675039" contextRef="i_2015-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2015Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USDPerPerShare" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:DerivativeCapPrice" scale="0">52.06</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;as well as to offset potential cash payments the Company is required to make in excess of the principal amount of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> in applicable events.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">The Capped Call is a separate transaction entered into by the Company with the option counterparties, is <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> part of the terms of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> and will <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> change the holders' rights under the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015.</em></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:24pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24pt;">In <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> September 2016, </em>the Company issued $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675045" contextRef="i_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" scale="3">287,500</ix:nonFraction> of <ix:nonFraction id="c56675046" contextRef="i_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="4" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2">0.75</ix:nonFraction>% convertible senior notes due <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2021</em> (Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and together with the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015,</em> the Convertible Notes). The Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> will mature <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> September 1, 2021, </em>unless earlier converted or repurchased. Interest on the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> is payable on <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> March 1 </em>and <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> September 1 </em>of each year, beginning on <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> March 1, 2017. </em>The initial conversion rate is <ix:nonFraction id="c56675052" contextRef="d_2016-01-01_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionRatio1" scale="0">17.7508</ix:nonFraction> shares of common stock per <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1</em> principal amount of Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> which represents an initial conversion price of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675055" contextRef="i_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0">56.34</ix:nonFraction> per share. The Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> will be subject to repurchase at the option of the holders following certain fundamental corporate changes, at a fundamental change in repurchase price equal to <ix:nonFraction id="c56675057" contextRef="d_2016-01-01_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" name="iphi:DebtInstrumentRepurchasePricePercentageOfPrincipalAmountRepurchased" scale="-2">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal amount of the notes to be repurchased, plus accrued and unpaid interest to, but excluding, the fundamental change repurchase date. The conversion rate will be subject to adjustment in some events but will <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> be adjusted for any accrued and unpaid interest. Certain corporate events that occur prior to the stated maturity date can cause the Company to increase the conversion rate for a holder.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24pt;">Prior to the close of business on the business day immediately preceding <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> March 1, 2021, </em>holders <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>convert all or any portion of their Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> only under the following circumstances: (i) during any calendar quarter commencing after the calendar quarter ending on <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2016 (</em>and only during such calendar quarter), if the last reported sale price of the Company&#x2019;s common stock for at least <ix:nonFraction id="c56675060" contextRef="d_2016-01-01_2016-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionCircumstance1Member_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdTradingDays" scale="0">20</ix:nonFraction> trading days (whether or <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> consecutive) during the period of <ix:nonFraction id="c56675062" contextRef="d_2016-01-01_2016-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionCircumstance1Member_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdConsecutiveTradingDays1" scale="0">30</ix:nonFraction> consecutive trading days ending on the last trading day of the immediately preceding calendar quarter is greater than or equal to <ix:nonFraction id="c56675063" contextRef="d_2016-01-01_2016-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionCircumstance1Member_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="1" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdPercentageOfStockPriceTrigger" scale="-2">130</ix:nonFraction>% of the conversion price on each applicable trading day; (ii) during the <ix:nonFraction id="c56675064" contextRef="d_2016-01-01_2016-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionCircumstance2Member_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdTradingDays" scale="0">five</ix:nonFraction> business day period after any <ix:nonFraction id="c56675065" contextRef="d_2016-01-01_2016-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionCircumstance2Member_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdConsecutiveTradingDays1" scale="0">five</ix:nonFraction> consecutive trading day period (the &#x201c;measurement period&#x201d;) in which the &#x201c;trading price&#x201d; per <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1</em> principal amount of notes, as determined following a request by a holder of notes in accordance with procedures specified in the indenture governing the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> for each trading day of the measurement period was less than <ix:nonFraction id="c56675068" contextRef="d_2016-01-01_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="2" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdPercentageOfStockPriceTrigger" scale="-2">98</ix:nonFraction>% of the product of the last reported sale price of the common stock and the conversion rate on each such trading day; or (iii) upon the occurrence of specified corporate events. On or after <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> March 1, 2021, </em>until the close of business on the <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">second</em> scheduled trading day immediately preceding the maturity date, holders <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>convert their notes at any time, regardless of the foregoing circumstances. Upon conversion, the Company will pay or deliver, as the case <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be, cash, shares of common stock or a combination of cash and shares of common stock, at the Company&#x2019;s election. The Company's current intent is to settle the principal amount of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> in cash upon conversion. If the conversion value exceeds the principal amount, the Company would deliver shares of its common stock in respect to the remainder of its conversion obligation in excess of the aggregate principal amount (conversion spread).</p>

   <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.2pt;text-align:center;"><b>Inphi Corporation</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.2pt;text-align:center;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.2pt;text-align:center;"><b>(Dollars in thousands except share and per share amounts)</b></p></ix:exclude><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.2pt;text-align:center;"><b></b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24pt;">The Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> are <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> redeemable at the Company&#x2019;s option prior to maturity.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24pt;">The Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> are governed by the terms of an indenture (Indenture <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em>). The Indenture <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> does <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> contain any financial or operating covenants, or restrictions on the payments of dividends, the incurrence of indebtedness or the issuance or repurchase of securities by the Company or any of its subsidiaries. The Indenture <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> contains customary terms and covenants in events of default. If an event of default (other than certain events of bankruptcy, insolvency or reorganization involving the Company) occurs and is continuing, the trustee under the Indenture <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> by notice to the Company, or the holders of at least <ix:nonFraction id="c56675080" contextRef="i_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="2" name="iphi:ConvertibleDebtHoldersInDefaultPercentOfPrincipalAmount" scale="-2">25</ix:nonFraction>% in principal amount of the outstanding Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> by notice to the Company and the trustee under the Indenture <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may, </em>and the trustee at the request of such holders shall, declare <ix:nonFraction id="c56675083" contextRef="i_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" name="iphi:ConvertibleDebtInDefaultPercentHoldersToDeclareDueAndPayable" scale="-2">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal of and accrued and unpaid interest, if any, on all the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> to be due and payable. Upon the occurrence of certain events of bankruptcy, insolvency or reorganization involving the Company, <ix:nonFraction id="c56675085" contextRef="i_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" name="iphi:ConvertibleDebtInBankruptcyInsolvencyAndReorganizationPercentDueAndPayable" scale="-2">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal of and accrued and unpaid interest, if any, on all of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> will become due and payable automatically. Upon such a declaration of acceleration, such principal and accrued and unpaid interest, if any, will be due and payable immediately. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Indenture <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> provides that, to the extent the Company elects, the sole remedy for an event of default relating to certain failures by the Company to comply with certain reporting covenants in the Indenture <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> consists exclusively of the right to receive additional interest on the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016.</em> As of <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2019</em>, <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">none</em> of the conditions allowing holders of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> to convert had been met.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24pt;">In accounting for the issuance of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> the Company separated the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> into liability and equity components. The carrying amount of the liability component was calculated by measuring the estimated fair value of a similar liability that does <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> have an associated convertible feature. The carrying amount of the equity component representing the conversion option was determined by deducting the fair value of the liability component from the face value of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> as a whole. The excess of the face amount of the liability component over its carrying amount is amortized to interest expense over the term of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> using the effective interest method. The gross proceeds of $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675097" contextRef="d_2016-01-01_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromConvertibleDebt" scale="3">287,500</ix:nonFraction> were accordingly allocated between long-term debt of $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675098" contextRef="i_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:ConvertibleDebt" scale="3">216,775</ix:nonFraction> and stockholders' equity of $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675099" contextRef="d_2016-01-01_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalEquityComponentOfConvertibleDebt" scale="3">70,725</ix:nonFraction>. Issuance costs of $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675100" contextRef="i_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="iphi:DebtAndEquityIssuanceCostsNet" scale="3">7,689</ix:nonFraction>, were allocated between long-term debt ($<ix:nonFraction id="c56675101" contextRef="i_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsGross" scale="3">5,798</ix:nonFraction>) and equity ($<ix:nonFraction id="c56675102" contextRef="i_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="iphi:DebtInstrumentConvertibleEquityComponentIssuanceCost" scale="3">1,891</ix:nonFraction>).</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24pt;">Interest expense for the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> are as follows:</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24pt;">In connection with the issuance of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> the Company entered into capped call transactions (Capped Call <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em>) in private transactions. Under the Capped Call <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> the Company purchased capped call options that in aggregate relate to <ix:nonFraction id="c56675107" contextRef="i_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" name="iphi:ConvertibleDebtInDefaultPercentHoldersToDeclareDueAndPayable" scale="-2">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the total number of shares of the Company's common stock underlying the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> with a strike price approximately equal to the conversion price of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and with a cap price equal to approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675110" contextRef="i_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USDPerPerShare" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:DerivativeCapPrice" scale="0">73.03</ix:nonFraction> per share. The capped calls were purchased for $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675111" contextRef="d_2016-01-01_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-4" name="iphi:PaymentsForCallOptions" scale="3">22,540</ix:nonFraction> and recorded as a reduction to additional paid-in-capital in accordance with ASC <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">815</em>-<em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">40,</em> Contracts in Entity&#x2019;s Own Equity.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:24pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24pt;">The purchased Capped Call <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> allows the Company to receive shares of its common stock and/or cash from counterparties equal to the amounts of common stock and/or cash related to the excess of the market price per share of the common stock, as measured under the terms of the Capped Call <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> over the strike price of the Capped Call <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> during the relevant valuation period. The purchased Capped Call <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> is intended to reduce the potential dilution to common stock upon future conversion of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> by effectively increasing the initial conversion price to approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675119" contextRef="i_2016-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleNotes2016Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember" unitRef="USDPerPerShare" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:DerivativeCapPrice" scale="0">73.03</ix:nonFraction> as well as to offset potential cash payments the Company is required to make in excess of the principal amount of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> in applicable events.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24pt;">The Capped Call <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> is a separate transaction entered into by the Company with the option counterparties, is <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> part of the terms of the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and will <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> change the holders' rights under the Convertible Notes <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016.</em></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b></b></p><ix:exclude><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>&#xa0;</b></p>

   <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.2pt;text-align:center;"><b>Inphi Corporation</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.2pt;text-align:center;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.2pt;text-align:center;"><b>(Dollars in thousands except share and per share amounts)</b></p>
   <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&#xa0;</p></ix:exclude><p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left"></p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 9pt;">&#xa0;&#xa0;&#xa0;&#xa0;&#xa0;&#xa0;On <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 22, 2017, </em>the Tax Reform Act was signed into law. The Tax Reform Act contains significant changes to U.S. federal corporate income taxation, including a reduction of the corporate tax rate from <ix:nonFraction id="c56675219" contextRef="d_2017-01-01_2017-12-31" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="2" name="iphi:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtHighestFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRatePercent" scale="-2">35</ix:nonFraction>% to <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">21%</em> effective <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> January 1, 2018, </em>a <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em>-time transition tax on deemed mandatory repatriation of accumulated earnings and profits of foreign subsidiaries in conjunction with the elimination of U.S. tax on dividend distributions from foreign subsidiaries, and a temporary <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">100%</em> <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">first</em>-year depreciation deduction for certain capital investments. In <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> the Company recorded provisional amounts based on reasonable estimates for certain enactment-date effects of the Tax Reform Act in accordance with the guidance in SAB <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">118.</em> In <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> the Company recorded a net tax benefit related to the enactment-date effects of the Tax Reform Act that included the remeasurement of the federal deferred tax assets and liabilities, the tax effect of the <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em>-time mandatory repatriation income, and related valuation allowance adjustments.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">During <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018,</em> the Company finalized the calculation of the deemed mandatory repatriation income upon filing its <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> U.S. income tax return. The change in the mandatory repatriation income was fully absorbed by the U.S. net operating loss, which is subject to valuation allowance, and resulted in <ix:nonFraction id="c56675230" contextRef="i_2019-12-31" unitRef="USD" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:TaxCutsAndJobsActOf2017TransitionTaxForAccumulatedForeignEarningsLiability" scale="3">no</ix:nonFraction> current tax liability. These measurement period adjustments had <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> net tax effect after the offsetting change to the valuation allowance.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">The Tax Reform Act subjects a U.S. shareholder to tax on GILTI&#xa0;earned by certain foreign subsidiaries. In <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> January 2018, </em>the FASB released guidance on the accounting for tax on the GILTI inclusion. Entities can make an accounting policy election to either recognize deferred taxes for temporary basis differences expected to reverse as GILTI in future years or account for GILTI as a period cost in the year the tax is incurred. The Company has elected to account for GILTI as a period cost in the year the tax is incurred. For the year ended <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2019</em>, the Company computed <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> GILTI inclusion as a result of current year aggregate loss of the Company&#x2019;s foreign subsidiaries.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:22.5pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>Valuation Allowance </b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24.5pt;">The Company records a valuation allowance to reduce deferred tax assets to the amount the Company believes is more likely than <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> to be realized. The determination of recording or releasing tax valuation allowances is made, in part, pursuant to an assessment performed by management regarding the likelihood that the Company will generate sufficient future taxable income against which benefits of the deferred tax assets <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>or <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em><em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> be realized. This assessment requires management to exercise significant judgment and make estimates with respect to the Company&#x2019;s ability to generate revenue, gross profits, operating income and taxable income in future periods. Amongst other factors, management must make assumptions regarding overall current and projected business and semiconductor industry conditions, operating efficiencies, the Company&#x2019;s ability to timely develop, introduce and consistently manufacture new products to customers&#x2019; specifications, acceptance of new products, customer concentrations, technological change and the competitive environment which <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>impact the Company&#x2019;s ability to generate taxable income and, in turn, realize the value of the deferred tax assets.&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">At <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2019, </em><em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> and <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> the Company has a full valuation allowance recorded against the deferred tax assets of Canada, United Kingdom, and the U.S., with the exception of the federal refundable AMT credit. The Company has a partial valuation allowance against the deferred tax assets of Taiwan.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">&#xa0;</p>

   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">As of <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2019</em>, the Company had approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675318" contextRef="i_2019-12-31" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsThatWouldImpactEffectiveTaxRate" scale="3">5,478</ix:nonFraction> of unrecognized tax benefits that if recognized would affect the effective income tax rate. The Company believes that before the end of next year, it is reasonably possible that the gross unrecognized tax benefit <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>decrease by approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675319" contextRef="i_2019-12-31" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:DecreaseInUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIsReasonablyPossible" scale="3">58</ix:nonFraction> due to statute of limitation expiration in foreign jurisdictions.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">The Company recognizes interest and penalties related to unrecognized tax benefits as a component of income tax expense. The Company recorded $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675320" contextRef="d_2019-01-01_2019-12-31" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAndInterestExpense" scale="3">16</ix:nonFraction>, $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675321" contextRef="d_2018-01-01_2018-12-31" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAndInterestExpense" scale="3">17</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675322" contextRef="d_2017-01-01_2017-12-31" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAndInterestExpense" scale="3">16</ix:nonFraction> in interest expense in the years ended <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2019, </em><em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> and <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em>, respectively. The Company had $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675325" contextRef="i_2019-12-31" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAndInterestAccrued" scale="3">56</ix:nonFraction>, $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675326" contextRef="i_2018-12-31" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAndInterestAccrued" scale="3">65</ix:nonFraction>, and $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675327" contextRef="i_2017-12-31" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAndInterestAccrued" scale="3">113</ix:nonFraction> of interest expense and penalties accrued as of <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2019, </em><em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> and <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em>, respectively.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">The Company files income tax returns in the U.S. federal jurisdiction, various states and certain foreign jurisdictions. The Company is <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> longer subject to U.S. federal income tax examinations for tax years ended on or before <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December&#xa0;</em><em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">31,</em> <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2011</em> or to California state income tax examinations for tax years ended on or before <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December&#xa0;</em><em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">31,</em> <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2010.</em> However, to the extent allowed by law, the tax authorities <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>have the right to examine prior periods where net operating losses or tax credits were generated and carried forward, and make adjustments up to the amount of the net operating loss or credit carryforward.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">The Company does <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> provide for U.S. income taxes on undistributed earnings of its controlled foreign corporations as the Company intends to reinvest these earnings indefinitely outside the United States.&#xa0; At <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2019</em>, foreign subsidiaries had cumulative undistributed earnings of $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675336" contextRef="i_2019-12-31" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:UndistributedEarningsOfForeignSubsidiaries" scale="3">31,008</ix:nonFraction> that, if repatriated, is expected to result in immaterial U.S. taxes.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 7.2pt; text-align: justify; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 22.5pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">The Company is currently under examination by the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (&#x201c;IRAS&#x201d;) for the years <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c56675337">2010,</span> <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2011</em> and <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2012.</em> The IRAS made an adjustment to the timing of deducting certain intercompany payments, the effect of which has been reflected in the provision and did <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> result in a material impact to the consolidated financial statements. As of the report date, the examination is ongoing.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 31.5pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 7.2pt; text-align: justify; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-indent: 18pt;">The Company is currently under examination by the U.S. Internal Revenue Service for year <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016.</em>&#xa0; The Company believes it has adequate reserve for its uncertain tax positions, however, there is <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> assurance that the taxing authorities will <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> propose adjustments that are different from the Company&#x2019;s expected outcome and such adjustments <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>impact the provision for income taxes.&#xa0; The Internal Revenue Service examination is on-going as of the report date.&#xa0;</p>

  <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2019-01-01_2019-12-31" name="us-gaap:DisclosureOfCompensationRelatedCostsShareBasedPaymentsTextBlock" id="c1446688" escape="true">
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b><em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1</em></b><b><em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2</em></b><b>. </b><b>Stock-</b><b>Based Compensation</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:27pt;">In <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 2010, </em>the Board of Directors (the &#x201c;Board&#x201d;) approved the Company&#x2019;s <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2010</em> Stock Incentive Plan (the <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">&#x201c;2010</em> Plan&#x201d;), which became effective in <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> November 2010. </em>The <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2010</em> Plan provides for the grants of restricted stock, stock appreciation rights and stock unit awards to employees, non-employee directors, advisors and consultants. The Compensation Committee administers the <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2010</em> Plan, including the determination of the recipient of an award, the number of shares subject to each award, whether an option is to be classified as an incentive stock option or nonstatutory option, and the terms and conditions of each award, including the exercise and purchase prices and the vesting or duration of the award. Options granted under the <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2010</em> Plan are exercisable only upon vesting. At <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2019</em>, <ix:nonFraction id="c56675531" contextRef="i_2019-12-31" unitRef="Share" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance" scale="0">4,909,665</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;shares of common stock have been reserved for future grants under the <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2010</em> Plan.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#xa0;</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:27pt;">The intrinsic value of options outstanding, exercisable and vested and expected to vest is calculated based on the difference between the exercise price and the fair value of the Company&#x2019;s common stock as of the respective balance sheet dates.</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:27pt;">The total intrinsic value of options exercised during the years ended <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2019, </em><em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> and <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> was $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675538" contextRef="d_2019-01-01_2019-12-31" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsExercisesInPeriodTotalIntrinsicValue" scale="3">12,008</ix:nonFraction>, $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675539" contextRef="d_2018-01-01_2018-12-31" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsExercisesInPeriodTotalIntrinsicValue" scale="3">4,553</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675540" contextRef="d_2017-01-01_2017-12-31" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsExercisesInPeriodTotalIntrinsicValue" scale="3">11,312</ix:nonFraction>, respectively. The intrinsic value of exercised options is calculated based on the difference between the exercise price and the fair value of the Company&#x2019;s common stock as of the exercise date. Cash received from the exercise of stock options was $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675541" contextRef="d_2019-01-01_2019-12-31" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromStockOptionsExercised" scale="3">2,616</ix:nonFraction>, $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675542" contextRef="d_2018-01-01_2018-12-31" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromStockOptionsExercised" scale="3">719</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675543" contextRef="d_2017-01-01_2017-12-31" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromStockOptionsExercised" scale="3">2,214</ix:nonFraction>, respectively, for the years ended <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2019, </em><em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> and <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em>.</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b><i>Restricted Stock Units and Awards</i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:27pt;">The Company granted restricted stock units (&#x201c;RSUs&#x201d;) to members of the Board and its employees. Most of the Company&#x2019;s outstanding RSUs vest over <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c56675547">four</span> years with vesting contingent upon continuous service. The Company estimates the fair value of RSUs using the market price of the common stock on the date of the grant. The fair value of these awards is amortized on a straight-line basis over the vesting period.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:27pt;">&#xa0;</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:27pt;">The RSUs include performance-based stock units subject to achievement of pre-established revenue and earnings per share goals on non-GAAP basis. Once the goals are met, the performance-based stock units are subject to <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c56675548">four</span> years of vesting from the original grant date, contingent upon continuous service. The total performance-based units that vested for the year ended <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2019</em> was&#xa0;<ix:nonFraction id="c56675549" contextRef="d_2019-01-01_2019-12-31_AwardTypeAxis-PerformanceSharesMember" unitRef="Share" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsVestedInPeriod" scale="0">55,759</ix:nonFraction>. As of <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2019</em>, the total performance-based units outstanding was <ix:nonFraction id="c56675550" contextRef="i_2019-12-31_AwardTypeAxis-PerformanceSharesMember" unitRef="Share" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsNonvestedNumber" scale="0">72,053</ix:nonFraction>.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:27pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b><i>Market Value Stock Units </i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:27pt;">In <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> January 2018, </em>the compensation committee of the Board approved long-term market value stock unit (MVSU) awards to certain executive officers and employees, subject to certain market and service conditions in the maximum total amount of <ix:nonFraction id="c56675551" contextRef="d_2018-01-01_2018-01-31_AwardTypeAxis-MarketValueStockUnitsMember" unitRef="Share" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsGrantsInPeriod" scale="0">702,000</ix:nonFraction> units. Recipients <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>earn between <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c56675552">0%</span> to <ix:nonFraction id="c56675553" contextRef="d_2018-01-01_2018-01-31_AwardTypeAxis-MarketValueStockUnitsMember_RangeAxis-MaximumMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="2" name="iphi:PercentageOfTargetNumberOfShares" scale="-2">225</ix:nonFraction>% of the target number of shares based on the Company&#x2019;s achievement of total shareholder return (TSR) in comparison to the TSR of companies in the S&amp;P <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">500</em> Index over a period of approximately <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> years in length ending in the <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">first</em> calendar quarter of <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2021</em> after reporting of fiscal year <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2020</em> results. If the Company&#x2019;s absolute TSR is negative for the performance period, then the maximum number of shares that <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be earned is the target number of shares. The fair value of the MVSU awards was estimated using a Monte Carlo simulation model and compensation is being recognized ratably over the service&#xa0;period. The expected volatility of the Company&#x2019;s common stock was estimated based on the historical average volatility rate over the <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c56675559">three</span>-year period. The dividend yield assumption was based on historical and anticipated dividend payouts. The risk-free interest rate assumption was based on observed interest rates consistent with <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em>-year measurement period. The total amount of compensation to recognize&#xa0;over the service period, and the assumptions used to value the grants are as follows:</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b><i>Employee Stock Purchase Plan</i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:27pt;">In <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 2011, </em>the Company adopted the Employee Stock Purchase Plan (&#x201c;ESPP&#x201d;). Participants purchase the Company's stock using payroll deductions, which <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em><em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> exceed <ix:nonFraction id="c56675562" contextRef="d_2011-12-01_2011-12-31_PlanNameAxis-EmployeeStockPurchasePlanMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="2" name="iphi:MaximumPercentageOfAggregateCashCompensationForPurchaseOfStockUsingPayrollDeduction" scale="-2">15</ix:nonFraction>% of their total cash compensation. Pursuant to the terms of the ESPP, the "look-back" period for the stock purchase price is <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">six</em> months. Offering and purchase periods will begin on <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> February 10 </em>and <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> August 10 </em>of each year. Participants will be granted the right to purchase common stock at a price per share that is <ix:nonFraction id="c56675564" contextRef="d_2011-12-01_2011-12-31_PlanNameAxis-EmployeeStockPurchasePlanMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="2" name="iphi:PurchasePricePershareAsPercentageOfMarketValue" scale="-2">85</ix:nonFraction>% of the lesser of the fair market value of the Company's common shares at the beginning or the end of each <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">six</em>-month period.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:27pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:27pt;">The ESPP imposes certain limitations upon an employee&#x2019;s right to acquire common stock, including the following: (i) <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> employee shall be granted a right to participate if such employee immediately after the election to purchase common stock, would own stock possessing <ix:nonFraction id="c56675567" contextRef="d_2011-12-01_2011-12-31_PlanNameAxis-EmployeeStockPurchasePlanMember" unitRef="Pure" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="2" name="iphi:PercentageOfCombinedVotingPowerOrValueOfAllClassesOfStockNotEligibleToParticipate" scale="-2">5</ix:nonFraction>% or more to the total combined voting power or value of all classes of stock of the Company, and (ii) <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> employee <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be granted rights to purchase more than $<ix:nonFraction id="c56675569" contextRef="d_2011-12-01_2011-12-31_PlanNameAxis-EmployeeStockPurchasePlanMember" unitRef="USD" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" name="iphi:FairValueOfCommonStockInCalendarYearPerEmployeeNotEligibleToParticipate" scale="3">25</ix:nonFraction> fair value of common stock for each calendar year. The maximum aggregate number of shares of common stock available for purchase under the ESPP is <ix:nonFraction id="c56675570" contextRef="d_2019-01-01_2019-12-31_PlanNameAxis-EmployeeStockPurchasePlanMember" unitRef="Share" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="iphi:MaximumAggregateNumberOfSharesOfCommonStockAvailableForPurchaseUnderEmployeeStockPurchasePlan" scale="0">2,750,000</ix:nonFraction>. Total common stock issued under the ESPP during the years ended <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2019, </em><em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> and <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> was <ix:nonFraction id="c56675573" contextRef="d_2019-01-01_2019-12-31" unitRef="Share" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmployeeStockPurchasePlans" scale="0">208,721</ix:nonFraction>, <ix:nonFraction id="c56675574" contextRef="d_2018-01-01_2018-12-31" unitRef="Share" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmployeeStockPurchasePlans" scale="0">283,493</ix:nonFraction>, and <ix:nonFraction id="c56675575" contextRef="d_2017-01-01_2017-12-31" unitRef="Share" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmployeeStockPurchasePlans" scale="0">171,099</ix:nonFraction>, respectively.</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b><em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1</em></b><b><em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">4</em></b><b>. Fair Value Measurements </b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24.5pt;">The guidance on fair value measurements requires fair value measurements to be classified and disclosed in <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> of the following <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> categories:</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24.5pt;"><i>Level <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1</em></i>: Unadjusted quoted prices in active markets that are accessible at the measurement date for identical, unrestricted assets or liabilities;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24.5pt;"><i>Level <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2</em></i>: Quoted prices in markets that are <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> active, or inputs which are observable, either directly or indirectly, for substantially the full term of the asset or liability; or</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24.5pt;"><i>Level <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">3</em></i>: Prices or valuation techniques that require inputs that are both significant to the fair value measurement and unobservable (i.e., supported by little or <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> market activity).</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24.5pt;"></p><ix:exclude><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:24.5pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <div class="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-left: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt">
    <div class="PGNUM" style="text-align: center; width: 100%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
     <em style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">75</em>
